3. The discrete random variable \(X\) has probability distribution given by
\[\begin{array}{c|rrrrr}x&-1&0&1&2&3\\P(X=x)&\frac15&a&\frac1{10}&a&\frac15\end{array}\]
where \(a\) is a constant.
(a) Find the value of \(a\).
(b) Write down \(E(X)\).
(c) Find \(\operatorname{Var}(X)\).
The distribution is symmetric about 1, giving \(E(X)=1\).
